section_summary.evidence_source: Participants completed the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005; Brazilian Portuguese translation: Swami et al., 2011), which measures a facet of positive body image. Although a revised version of the BAS (i.e., the BAS-2) has been validated in Brazilian adolescents (Ibánez, ˜ Chiminazzo, Camacho, & Fernandes, 2017), this measure was not available when we began the study. Cronbach alpha for the 10-item BAS in the present study was .89.
